home.title: My characters
home.emptyHint: Choose a world below to create one.

worlds.title: Worlds
worlds.intro: Create a character in one of these worlds, then choose a story for them.
worlds.empty: No world can be played yet.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.empty: No scenario left to play in this world.

page.notFound: This character does not exist or is not yours.

abandonDialog.title: Abandon this scenario?
abandonDialog.body: {{scenario}} ends in failure: the game cannot be resumed. You can start the scenario again afterwards.

deleteGameDialog.title: Delete this game?
deleteGameDialog.body: The failed game of {{scenario}} leaves this page for good.

deleteCharacterDialog.title: Delete this character?
deleteCharacterDialog.body: {{name}} leaves your list for good, with the games they played.

creation.title: Create a character
creation.notFound: No character can be created in this world.

dice.intro: Seven times four six-sided dice, the best three kept: one result for each characteristic. Roll again as often as you like.
dice.rerollHint: A new roll replaces every result and clears their placement.

placement.intro: Give each result to a characteristic, each result once. Drag a result onto a characteristic, or pick it in the list.
placement.floor: Size and Intelligence never go below {{floor, number}}: a lower result placed there is raised.

profession.intro: What your character does for a living. Its skills get the professional points.

skills.intro: Spend the professional points on the skills of the profession, the personal points on any skill.
skills.unspent_one: {{count, number}} point unspent: you can still go on.
skills.unspent_other: {{count, number}} points unspent: you can still go on.
skills.cap: No skill may go above {{cap, number}}% at creation.
